component.name: LibraryCategoryItem
component.script:
sub init() m.label = m.top.findNode("label") m.background = m.top.findNode("background") m.top.observeFieldScoped("title", "titleChanged") end sub
sub titleChanged() m.label.text = m.top.title end sub
sub onGainedFocus(isFocused as boolean) if isFocused m.background.color = "0x00a4dcFF" else m.background.color = "0x333333FF" end if end sub
